fact: Gabonreview reports ANPI-Gabon has digitalised the company-creation process on the Guichet Numérique de l'Investissement, launched three years earlier, and added a bank module on 1 June 2023.

ANPI-Gabon's annual report says all company creation and fee-payment procedures are dematerialised on the Guichet Numérique de l'Investissement, with 7,146 files submitted and paid from June 2020 to May 2021.
